name: Glitch Walk
concept: A walk that behaves like a corrupted video stream: normal forward motion punctuated by dropped frames, dead-stop freezes, a short rewind and a visible 'recalibration' of the body. The joke and the hook are the same thing — reality buffering.
hook: You step forward — and the universe drops frames.
firstSecond: Frame zero is a hard freeze mid-stride. Within 0.8s the body snaps forward through three stutter-steps, each one landing on a dead stop.

sequence.name: Hard freeze
sequence.description: Start frozen mid-stride, arms locked. Snap forward through three stutter-steps, each ending in a dead stop.

sequence.name: Signal drop
sequence.description: Walk forward normally; every second step the torso jerks back a few centimetres as if frames were dropped, then resumes.

sequence.name: Buffer
sequence.description: Full freeze: lifted foot, tilted head, mismatched arm angles. Hold 0.6s.

sequence.name: Rewind
sequence.description: Three choppy steps backwards at double speed.

sequence.name: Correction
sequence.description: The body recalibrates: head, shoulders, then hips each snap back to centre in sequence.

sequence.name: Resume
sequence.description: Smooth forward walk that decelerates into the opening mid-stride freeze.

signature: The Buffer: one foot lifted, head tilted about 30°, arms locked at mismatched angles, held perfectly still for 0.6s before snapping back to normal walking.
loopPoint: The final step lands in the same mid-stride freeze as frame zero, so the clip loops without a visible seam.
cameraGuidance: Locked-off camera at chest height, performer walks toward the lens and stays fully in frame (head to feet) for the whole take.
motionTransferConsiderations: Freezes must be truly static in the reference; micro-drift reads as model jitter, not intent.
Keep total forward travel under ~1.5m so the performer never leaves frame or changes scale dramatically.
Avoid arm-over-face occlusion during the Buffer pose.
generationGuidance: Motion must come from an owned reference performance. Prompt only describes scene and identity preservation. Prefer character orientation from the reference video. Keep the reference audio off.

referenceCapture.performerBrief: One performer walks toward a locked-off camera over ~1.5m, executing the six phases. Freezes must be dead still (practice holding breath on freezes). Arms stay away from the face.
referenceCapture.wardrobe: Fitted clothing with visible arm/leg lines; no long coats, no hats covering the face.
referenceCapture.framing: Portrait 9:16 (1080x1920 preferred), head-to-feet always in frame with ~10% headroom, plain background, even lighting.
